[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2g[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Large fuzzy Active Task Picker for `^` in Bob Mac Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `^` as a capture item in Bob Mac Capture opens a large, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]keyboard-first Active Task Picker. It lists every In Progress and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Next task grouped by today's Pomodoro plan, filters them instantly [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with fuzzy matching, and inserts the chosen `route:block-id` [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]reliably. It never shows red incomplete-marker errors while you [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pick.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fuzzy matcher and picker presentation engine (CaptureCore)[/bold #D7AFFF]    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core: add a pure, Foundation-only fuzzy matcher, the task display-text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]parser for code spans and wikilinks, and the grouped/filtered picker [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]presentation with navigation helpers. Ship thorough CaptureCore unit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests; the app's behavior does not change.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Picker state machine, keyboard routing, focus, and a [/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]functional picker view[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]picker-flow[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]picker-flow: route `active_task` completion into a modal picker state. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]This covers open, suppress, and reopen rules, full-snapshot fetch, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accept and accept-and-submit, the two-stage Escape, trigger removal on [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Backspace, and the reopen chip. Add picker key routing, an AppKit-owned [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]filter field, and live-preview suppression for an incomplete `^`. Ship a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]plain but fully working picker view, fake-bob fixtures, tests, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]README behavior docs.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Beautiful picker card, sizing, accessibility, docs, and macOS [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]verification[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]picker-design[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core, picker-flow[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]picker-design: replace the functional view with the final design, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]including the large card, pinned Pomodoro headers, rich rows, detail [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]strip, empty states, chip, and key-hint footer. Add the fixed-height [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sizing policy, accessibility announcements, README visuals, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rendered-image review, and macOS build, test, and lint verification.[/#D7D7AF]
